scope: Source-audited review of 20 published European landscape identities; 11 attributable financing, equity, debt and grant events for 7 companies approved pending rollback rehearsal.

sources.title: PCO confirms PLN261m Capital Investment Fund support for production expansion

rounds.note_en: PCO states that it received PLN261m from the Capital Investment Fund through Polska Grupa Zbrojeniowa for a PLN271m production-capacity expansion. The project budget is not presented as company financing.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The company-specific support is recorded. Other PCO consortium projects require beneficiary-level allocation before attribution.

sources.title: Iron Wolf Capital confirms co-leading PDKINEMATICS' EUR2m seed

rounds.note_en: The investor announcement names the two co-leads and unnamed defence angels. Unnamed participants are not invented.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The EUR2m seed is recorded. Reporting says total funding reached EUR3m, but the earlier EUR1m is not split into a source-supported dated event.

sources.title: Pelixar disclosed an obtained EU grant before its Beesfund campaign
PPNT Gdynia describes Pelixar's grant-backed R&D project and crowdfunding launch

rounds.note_en: Sources confirm an obtained EU-backed grant covering 76% of a PLN1.3m R&D project. No derived grant amount is stored because the award itself is not quoted as an original-currency amount.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The grant is recorded as amount-undisclosed. The 2019 Beesfund share offer was launched, but a closed raise and proceeds were not established.

sources.title: Piaggio Aero confirms fully subscribed EUR190m capital increase

rounds.note_en: Piaggio Aero Industries reported completion of the fully subscribed increase and named the subscribing shareholders; individual cheque sizes are not inferred.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2013 capital increase is recorded. A 2020 EUR30m facility covered two companies under the Piaggio Aerospace brand and is held rather than assigned to one issuer; Baykar's acquisition was a secondary business sale.

sources.title: POLARIS disclosed a 2023 investment by MBB Bremen

rounds.note_en: The company disclosed the 2023 MBB investment in February 2024 without an amount or more precise event date.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The disclosed early investment is captured without guessing its size.

sources.title: POLARIS closed a significant bridge round with E2MC Ventures and Andreas Kupke

rounds.note_en: The amount was described only as significant and remains undisclosed.
rounds.coverage_note_en: This bridge is separated from the earlier MBB disclosure and later Dienes investment.

sources.title: POLARIS disclosed its largest investment to date from Dienes Holding

rounds.note_en: POLARIS named Dienes Holding and reported EUR7.1m cumulative funding, but did not disclose the individual investment amount.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The participant and event are recorded without converting the cumulative total into a round amount.

sources.title: POLARIS announces oversubscribed EUR5.3m seed top-up

rounds.note_en: The company announcement gives EUR5.3m; a secondary report rounded this to EUR5.4m. The original company amount is retained.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The top-up brought disclosed private funding to EUR12.4m. The residual early funding is not manufactured into additional events.

sources.title: Prague Stock Exchange reports Primoco UAV's 2018 IPO proceeds

rounds.note_en: The exchange reports CZK63.125m raised from investors and explicitly describes the IPO as non-debt financing to the company.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The primary offering proceeds are recorded; secondary market transactions are not issuer financing.

sources.title: Prague Stock Exchange reports Primoco UAV's 2021 subscription proceeds

rounds.note_en: The exchange reports CZK40.534m raised from investors in the 2021 subscription.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Together with the 2018 IPO, the exchange reports CZK103.7m total proceeds. A later PLATH stake purchase is not treated as primary issuer financing.

sources.title: Polish Treasury agreed PLN44m staged subscription of PGZ shares

rounds.note_en: The Treasury-PGZ agreement set a PLN44m share subscription in three stages, earmarked for PIT-RADWAR's radar test facility. The source confirms PLN12.3024m paid on 4 September 2015 and a PLN20.4203m second subscription; the overall signed amount is recorded once rather than double-counting tranches.
rounds.coverage_note_en: This issuer-level capital increase is recorded for PGZ. The downstream PIT-RADWAR project support is not also represented as PIT-RADWAR financing.
